records.text: Elder Bluewolf recalls living for the hunt, glory and honor, and asks whether the present is so different. Bluewolf speaks of spirit enduring beyond death and offers visitors a token and good wishes.
A goblin Demolisher Engineer at Wintergrasp who offers to build catapults and demolishers.
Travis Day is a legacy weaponsmith who sells goods to visitors.
Morgan Day is a jewelcrafter who sells goods to visitors.
The Gnomish Engineer is a demolisher engineer involved in preparing catapults and demolishers. One recorded reply says that all spare parts have been used.
Wandering Shadow is a shadow creature that chills its foes with Chilling Touch and saps them with Curse of Weakness.
Living Lasher is an elemental that lies submerged.
Arzo Safeflight is a flight master who helps travelers make fast journeys. When attacked, he summons an enraged gryphon and an enraged wyvern.
Herzo Safeflight is a flight master who helps travelers make fast journeys. When attacked, he summons an enraged gryphon and an enraged wyvern.
An undead Shadow Revenant that uses Strangulate while fighting.

A Flame Revenant is a fire elemental of Wintergrasp’s Cauldron of Flames. Eternal Embers taken from these creatures are gathered to fuel the Horde’s siege engines, tying the revenant to the war effort at the site.
A Tempest Revenant elemental found in Dragonblight and Wintergrasp.
An Earthbound Revenant elemental found in Wintergrasp.
A Water Revenant is an elemental found across Wintergrasp, one of the elementals that slay adventurers in the Glacial Falls.

Commander Zanneth is an Alliance commander in the Wintergrasp fight. He urges victory, calls the Horde animals, and announces the fall of their towers while pressing Alliance fighters to finish the remaining forces. His assigned mission targets Horde combatants, and he asks whether it is complete. His lines make him a forceful, openly anti-Horde leader focused on the battle.

Sorceress Kaylana is an enchantress whose research finds unusual energy in armor left at Glacial Falls, where Horde forces have been gathering it. She is concerned with replenishing supplies and preparing for another assault on Wintergrasp Fortress, and asks for the imbued armor to be brought to her for that purpose.

Bowyer Randolph equips Wintergrasp's archers with dragonbone arrowheads and speaks with enthusiasm about dragons and their bones. With Dragonblight bone difficult to obtain after the massacre at Angrathar, he looks to the Forest of Shadows for more. He has heard rumors that the place is haunted, though he says he never ventures there himself.

Primalist Mulfort treats the wounded with salves made from roses gathered at the Steppe of Life. He speaks of heavy losses among his people and sees more soldiers at risk without treatment; amid the fighting, he reflects that peace once seemed possible. The roses have become scarce as Alliance forces harvest them.

Anchorite Tessa serves at Wintergrasp Fortress. She recalls the stormy peaks of Kaarinos on Argus and prepares medicine from herb pouches to protect soldiers from the cold. She also warns about the lashers after they injured Private Doane.

Commander Dardosh welcomes visitors to Wintergrasp and asks whether they have come to serve the Horde in battle. He invokes Warlord Garrosh’s order to kill Alliance fighters, then urges the destruction of Alliance towers and remaining forces; his battlefield calls show an openly hostile stance toward the Alliance.

Fu'jin is a named Horde hexxer at Wintergrasp Fortress. The hexxer seeks strong warriors' souls for hoodoo wards and jinxes against the Alliance keep, looking for enchanted armor as evidence of those souls. The dialogue conveys unease about the spirits haunting the area.

Lieutenant Vieron Blazefeather is a named Horde officer who says he was a poet, not a ranger, and complains about being assigned to arm the archers. He needs dragon bone for arrowheads, wonders why he did not stay in Silvermoon like his brother, and hopes for a moment's rest.

Siegesmith Stronghoof is a named Horde siege worker preparing demolishers and siege engines for another assault on Wintergrasp. Stronghoof calls for eternal embers to fuel the machines and notes that fire elementals may yield embers if Alliance scavengers have left.

Lieutenant Murp is a Horde officer at Wintergrasp whose speech turns siege orders into personal boasts. He wants Alliance siege devices destroyed and wishes he could join the demolisher crews, but says he must remain in camp; he therefore asks others to defend them. He takes pride in his own plan and regrets missing the action.

Siege Master Stouthandle oversees preparation for Wintergrasp's next battle, including gathering eternal embers to fuel demolishers and siege engines. He is openly hostile to the Horde, urging that any found gathering embers be slain so they gain no advantage. He taunts anyone who returns without the embers.

Senior Demolitionist Legoso is an Alliance siege specialist who treats the assault as a demonstration of Gnomish engineering. He calls the Horde cowardly, urges the destruction of their machines, and wants siege crews to pilot or protect devices attacking the fortress. His praise centers on the power of Gnomish invention.

Kilrath is a Horde tactical officer involved in Wintergrasp's campaign. The orders attributed to him treat control of the fortress as a strategic priority and demand that recruits contribute directly. He also directs an attack on the southern towers, whose stolen power could strengthen Horde forces. His words show contempt for warlocks and the undead, though he accepts that even enemies he despises can be useful.

Ahbramis is a Valiance Expedition tactical officer involved in Wintergrasp's campaign. The orders attributed to him make control of the fortress a strategic priority and demand that recruits contribute directly. He also directs an attack on the southern towers, whose stolen power could strengthen his side's forces.
A Taunka spirit guide in Wintergrasp who offers routes to the Fortress and Sunken Ring graveyards.
A Dwarven spirit guide in Wintergrasp who offers routes to the Fortress and Sunken Ring graveyards.
A Mature Lasher is an elemental that lies submerged at home between fights. It surfaces when an enemy draws its attention, can move in combat, and lashes out with Dream Lash.

place_records.text: You are in Wintergrasp, a cold region of Northrend. The Horde holds it in places, at The Chilled Quagmire, and no settlement of the other side stands here. Chilled earth elementals, whispering winds, glacial spirits and water revenants haunt its ice, while wandering shadows and living lashers roam other parts of it.

You are in The Sunken Ring, a Wintergrasp area where people of the Horde and the Alliance both work. A goblin and a gnome, both demolisher engineers, work on catapults and demolishers. Elementals and revenants roam the ring, and taunka and dwarven spirit guides offer routes to the graveyards here.
You are in The Broken Temple, a Wintergrasp area where demolisher engineers of the Horde and the Alliance work on catapults and demolishers. Glacial spirits and water revenants haunt it.

You are in Wintergrasp Fortress, a Wintergrasp area with people of both sides. Travis Day, a weaponsmith, and Morgan Day, a jewelcrafter, sell goods to visitors, and a goblin and a gnome work on catapults and demolishers. Chilled earth elementals wander here.
You are in Eastern Bridge, a crossing in Wintergrasp. Glacial spirits and water revenants haunt it.

You are in The Cauldron of Flames, a Wintergrasp area. Raging flames, flame revenants and smoldering constructs haunt it, and a Burning Depths necromancer and a magmawyrm are among its dangers. A cinder cloud drifts here.
You are in Glacial Falls, an area of Wintergrasp. Glacial spirits and water revenants haunt it.
You are in The Forest of Shadows, an area of Wintergrasp. Wandering shadows and shadow revenants haunt it.

You are in The Chilled Quagmire, a Horde settlement in Wintergrasp. Herzo Safeflight, a Horde flight master, takes travelers on fast journeys by air, and spirit guides of both sides offer routes to the graveyards. Glacial spirits, water revenants and chilled earth elementals haunt the area.
You are in The Steppe of Life, an area of Wintergrasp. Living lashers and mature lashers roam it.

You are in Westspark Workshop, a Wintergrasp workshop where demolisher engineers of the Horde and the Alliance work on catapults and demolishers. Spirit guides of both sides offer routes to the graveyards.
You are in Eastspark Workshop, a Wintergrasp workshop where a goblin and a gnome work on catapults and demolishers. A spirit healer offers a return to life for a price.
